name: Beauty of Joseon

lead: Beauty of Joseon is a Korean skincare brand that blends ingredients from traditional herbal medicine (hanbang), such as rice and green tea, with modern formulations. Its Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics sunscreen became its best-known product, especially in the United States.

Daily sunscreen is how users aim at the appearance payoff: limiting UV exposure that contributes to skin aging and uneven tone. The brand's popularity grew through social media and community feedback, and it says its products are cruelty-free and patch-tested.

paras: Relief Sun is a daily face sunscreen applied as the last step of a morning routine; users describe a lightweight texture. The brand also sells creams and serums for routines built around soothing the skin barrier.
As a cosmetic sunscreen, adverse effects are generally limited to individual irritation or allergy to an ingredient. The brand states it uses human repeat insult patch testing (HRIPT) for gentleness.

chain: Supports even tone and slower visible photoaging
angle.text: People use Relief Sun as an everyday SPF, aiming to keep skin looking smoother and more even by limiting sun damage. Many reviews describe the light texture as the reason they wear it daily.

lead: Beauty of Joseon is a South Korean skincare brand (Korean name Joseon Minyeo) that describes its products as clean, hanbang-inspired skincare combining traditional Korean herbal ingredients with modern, clinically tested components.[1] It says it draws on Joseon Dynasty beauty practices recorded in texts such as the Gyuhap Chongseo.[1]

The brand was launched in 2016 with the Joseon Beauty Cream and was later revamped by a team including Sumin Lee in 2019, shifting toward accessible products that gained viral popularity.[1] Its best-known product in the US is the Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics sunscreen, credited with helping change perceptions of daily SPF use within K-beauty routines.[1]

For looks, the sunscreen is used as a daily step to protect the skin from UV exposure, which is associated with photoaging and dark spots. The brand says its growth was community-driven, with feedback on Instagram and TikTok shaping product development.[1]

paras: The brand emphasizes ingredients from hanbang, traditional Korean herbal medicine, such as rice and green tea, alongside modern components. It states that it does not test on animals and puts products through HRIPT to confirm gentleness, including on sensitive skin.[1]
Its stated mission is to deliver routines that soothe and strengthen the skin barrier with minimal irritation for all skin types.[1]

Beauty of Joseon launched in 2016 with the Joseon Beauty Cream, reinterpreting beauty tips from the Joseon-era Gyuhap Chongseo, attributed to the scholar Yi Bingheogak.[1] After a 2019 revamp, it focused on lightweight, affordable products and gained global attention, particularly in the United States.[1]
Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics is the product most associated with the brand and is described as having redefined daily SPF in K-beauty routines in the US.[1]
No studies found of Beauty of Joseon products specifically. Research on sunscreens as a category examines UV protection and skin aging in general.

timeline.event: Brand launches with the Joseon Beauty Cream.[1]
